description: Mapping from IPN Hand labels to GestureFlow external dynamic labels. Production positives remain user-recorded; IPN is used as negative/reference evidence.

default.notes: Unknown IPN labels are skipped unless explicitly included.

D0X.notes: IPN non-gesture intervals become dynamic negative evidence.

B0A.notes: Pointing with one finger is not a GestureFlow dynamic command.

B0B.notes: Pointing with two fingers is not a GestureFlow dynamic command.

G01.notes: Click with one finger is unrelated dynamic evidence.

G02.notes: Click with two fingers is unrelated dynamic evidence.

G03.notes: Throw up is close to swipe_up; keep out of negative training by default.

G04.notes: Throw down is close to swipe_down; keep out of negative training by default.

G05.notes: Throw left is close to swipe_left; keep out of negative training by default.

G06.notes: Throw right is close to swipe_right; keep out of negative training by default.

G07.notes: Open twice is a dynamic hand action but not a current user command.

G08.notes: Double click with one finger is unrelated dynamic evidence.

G09.notes: Double click with two fingers is unrelated dynamic evidence.

G10.notes: Zoom in is a dynamic action but not a current user command.

G11.notes: Zoom out is a dynamic action but not a current user command.
